
```{r}
df |>
```

## Main Models to Estimate the ATEs

```{r}
# Model data
df_info <- df |> 
  mutate(
    polinfo_choice = case_when(
      exp_polinfo == "No, I do not want to see information on how to get more involved in democracy" ~ 0,
      exp_polinfo == "Yes, I want to see information on how to get more involved in democracy" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    polinfo_time = exp_polinfo_time
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    polinfo = if_else(polinfo_choice == 1, polinfo_time, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# brms settings
bayes_seed <- 42
chains <- 4
iter <- 4000
warmup <- floor(iter/2)
adapt_delta <- 0.90
max_treedepth <- 10
```

```{r}
# marginaleffects settings
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "hdi")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)
```

### Model 1 — Primary Model

```{r}
f_hu1 <- bf(
  polinfo ~ exp_condition,
  hu ~ exp_condition)

priors_hu1 <- c(
  prior(normal(2, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", dpar = "hu"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", dpar = "hu"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
hu1 <- brm(
  data = df_info,
  formula = f_hu1,
  family = hurdle_lognormal(),
  prior = priors_hu1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  ),
  file = here(model_dir, "hu1.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(hu1)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

##### Initiation of Information Seeking

```{r}
iis1_pred_avg <- avg_predictions(hu1,
                               dpar = "hu") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(Median = 1 - estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = 1 - conf.high,
         "95% HDI Upper" = 1 - conf.low
         ) |> 
  select(Median,
         "95% HDI Lower",
         "95% HDI Upper" 
         ) 

iis1_pred_avg |> tt()
```

```{r}
iis1_pred <- avg_predictions(hu1, 
                             dpar = "hu",
                             by = "exp_condition") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  # Flip the direction as hu models decision NOT to view
  mutate(Median = 1 - estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = 1 - conf.high,
         "95% HDI Upper" = 1 - conf.low
         ) |> 
  select(Condition = exp_condition,
         Median,
         "95% HDI Lower",
         "95% HDI Upper" 
         ) 

iis1_pred |> tt()
```

```{r}
iis1_comp <- avg_comparisons(hu1, 
                            dpar = "hu", 
                            variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

iis1_comp |> tt()
```

##### Extent of Information Seeking

```{r}
eis1_pred_avg <- avg_predictions(hu1,
                                dpar = "mu",
                                transform = exp # Translates the log-scale mu to the natural scale median
                                ) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high 
         ) 

eis1_pred_avg |> tt()
```

```{r}
eis1_pred <- avg_predictions(hu1, 
                             dpar = "mu",
                             by = "exp_condition",
                             transform = exp) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Condition = exp_condition,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high 
         ) 

eis1_pred |> tt()
```

```{r}
eis1_comp <- avg_comparisons(hu1, 
                             dpar = "mu",
                             comparison = function(hi, lo) exp(hi) - exp(lo),
                             variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

eis1_comp |> tt()
```

### Model 2 — Interaction with Age Group

```{r}
f_hu2 <- bf(
  polinfo ~ exp_condition * age_group,
  hu ~ exp_condition * age_group)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
hu2 <- brm(
  data = df_info,
  formula = f_hu2,
  family = hurdle_lognormal(),
  prior = priors_hu1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  ),
  file = here(model_dir, "hu2.rds")
)
```

```{r}
summary(hu2)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

##### Association with Age Group

Difference in the probability of viewing the information between age groups, averaged across conditions (the hurdle part models the decision *not* to view, so the contrast is computed as lo - hi):

```{r}
iis2_mod_comps <- avg_comparisons(hu2, 
                                  dpar = "hu", 
                                  variables = list(age_group = "pairwise"), 
                                  comparison = function(hi, lo) lo - hi,
                                  newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, age_group = unique)) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(contrast = str_replace(contrast, ", ", " - ")) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

iis2_mod_comps |> tt()
```

Difference in viewing time (seconds) between age groups, averaged across conditions:

```{r}
eis2_mod_comps <- avg_comparisons(hu2, 
                                  dpar = "mu", 
                                  variables = list(age_group = "pairwise"), 
                                  comparison = function(hi, lo) exp(hi) - exp(lo),
                                  newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, age_group = unique)) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(contrast = str_replace(contrast, ", ", " - ")) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

eis2_mod_comps |> tt()
```

##### Initiation of Information Seeking

```{r}
iis2_comp <- avg_comparisons(hu2, 
                             dpar = "hu", 
                             variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), 
                             by = "age_group") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age Group` = age_group,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

iis2_comp |> tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects on the probability of viewing the information between age groups:

```{r}
iis2_comp_diffs <- avg_comparisons(hu2, 
                                   dpar = "hu", 
                                   variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), 
                                   comparison = function(hi, lo) lo - hi,
                                   by = "age_group",
                                   hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(contrast = str_replace(contrast, ", ", " - ")) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age Group Difference` = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

iis2_comp_diffs |> tt()
```

##### Extent of Information Seeking

```{r}
eis2_comp <- avg_comparisons(hu2, 
                             dpar = "mu",
                             variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), 
                             comparison = function(hi, lo) exp(hi) - exp(lo),
                             by = "age_group") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age Group` = age_group,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

eis2_comp |> tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects on viewing time (seconds) between age groups:

```{r}

                                   dpar = "mu",
                                   variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), 
                                   comparison = function(hi, lo) exp(hi) - exp(lo),
                                   by = "age_group",
                                   hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(contrast = str_replace(contrast, ", ", " - ")) |>

         `Age Group Difference` = hypothesis,
```

## Supplementary Models

### Model 4 — Control for Demographics

```{r}
df_control <- df_info |> 
  mutate(ideology = left_right / 10,
         education_level = coalesce(education_level, education)) |> 
  droplevels()

f_hu4 <- bf(
  polinfo ~ exp_condition + scale(age) + gender + ideology + education_level + living_standard,
  hu ~ exp_condition + scale(age) + gender + ideology + education_level + living_standard)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
hu4 <- brm(
  data = df_control,
  formula = f_hu4,
  family = hurdle_lognormal(),
  prior = priors_hu1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  ),
  file = here(model_dir, "hu4.rds")
)
```

```{r}
print(hu4)
```

```{r}
iis4_comp |> tt()
```

## Exploratory Moderation Models

Moderation of the treatment effects on initiation and extent of information seeking by subjective living standard, age (continuous), and parental ideology. Living standard: difficult and very difficult combined given the small number of respondents in "very difficult" (<5%). Continuous moderators are standardised for estimation; as neither part of the hurdle model is linear on the reported scale, treatment effects are reported at representative values (age 16, 21, 26; parental ideology 0, 5, 10), and moderation as the difference between the highest and lowest value. Initiation is reported as the probability of viewing the information (i.e., 1 - hu).

```{r}
df_info_het <- df_info |>
  mutate(
    living_standard = fct_collapse(
      living_standard,
      Comfortable = levels(living_standard)[1],
      Coping = levels(living_standard)[2],
      Difficult = levels(living_standard)[3:4]
    ) |> fct_rev()
  )

age_mean <- mean(df_info_het$age)
age_sd <- sd(df_info_het$age)
to_age_z <- \(x) (x - age_mean) / age_sd

pi_mean <- mean(df_info_het$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
pi_sd <- sd(df_info_het$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
to_pi_z <- \(x) (x - pi_mean) / pi_sd

df_info_het <- df_info_het |>
  mutate(age_z = to_age_z(age),
         parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(parental_ideology))

df_info_het |> count(living_standard)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

##### Association with Age

Probability of viewing the information at age 16 and 26, averaged across conditions:

```{r}
iis9_mod_pred <- avg_predictions(hu9,
                                  dpar = "hu",
                                  newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, age_z = to_age_z(c(16, 26))),
                                  by = "age_z") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  # Flip the direction as hu models decision NOT to view
  mutate(age = round(age_z * age_sd + age_mean),
         Median = 1 - estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = 1 - conf.high,
         "95% HDI Upper" = 1 - conf.low
         ) |> 
  select(`Age` = age,
         Median,
         "95% HDI Lower",
         "95% HDI Upper" 
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))
```
